rv.q: Maybe Happy Ending might just be one of the best musicals I've seen in years, if not ever.
For a musical that will leave you free of any preconceptions, and that will invigorate your mind and senses ---do not miss this musical---as we all hope for a Maybe Happy Ending .
Overall, no manufacturer defects can be found here.
This is a show that deserves to have a very long run, and one day earn the status as a true classic of musical theatre.
Beautifully bittersweet, Maybe Happy Ending serves as a delightful nudge to step out, venture from predictable routines, and take the leap to make a connection.
Rather, it pushes all the right buttons through its plucky sincerity, gentle humor and an unlikely romance that will all but melt your heart.

cn.t: Critics rave about this Tony-winning musical, praising its spectacular cast, stunning production design, and bittersweet story that uses robots to examine what it means to be human. A refreshingly original, deeply touching production.
